scientific_integrity: Exact extinction-basin theorem proved using the published finite-graph circulation criterion and a self-contained three-color Hall-obstruction count. Prior published cocktail-party primitive-period and immediate-cycle classifications are fully credited; they are not represented as new. Original finite enumerators corroborate the restricted basin formula, while a fresh independent finite check was conducted for r=3,4,5. No external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only synchronous three-state threshold-one Greenberg–Hastings dynamics on K_(2,...,2) with r>=4. Exact extinction probability and basin count only; earlier work determines primitive periods and immediate periodic populations. No exact transient-entry-time histogram. Unindexed prior exact Hall counts remain a historical risk. No independent expert or formal attestation.
title: Exact extinction basin on cocktail-party graphs under three-state excitation
